video_title: EMERGENCY REACTION: Hornets Trade LaMelo Ball To The Wolves

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte's decision to trade LaMelo Ball to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: The Hornets restored the value of LaMelo Ball and they pounced on the opportunity to move off him.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Hornets restored the value of LaMelo Ball and they pounced on the opportunity to move off him and hit the reset button in terms of the culture of that franchise.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: And Riverboat Gambler Tim Connelly pounced on the opportunity to add a star-caliber player alongside Anthony Edwards to tell those vultures to go circle somewhere else for a little bit.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Goodwill
text_blocks.text: I think that's the sense that I got. I think it's because of the return that they got.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's career-best season and Jeff Peterson's skepticism
quotes.excerpt: He had the best season of his career. He was a driving force in the darling of the NBA.
quotes.quote: At this point last year, going into the season, I personally had a lot to say about LaMelo Ball, about how I didn't believe in him, about the immaturity, the erratic game, unreliability. He had the best season of his career. He was a driving force in the darling of the NBA, at least the second half of the season. They found that starting five that had the best net rating in the league, and clearly what happened was Jeff Peterson, the Hornets general manager, thought it was fool's gold. Didn't believe in it.

quotes.speaker: Vince Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's role as an influencer of winning
quotes.excerpt: I think LaMelo Ball is an influencer of winning. When you look at the usage, this year.
quotes.quote: I think LaMelo Ball is an influencer of winning. When you look at the usage, this year, and we don't think of him as being a top-10 player. His usage was higher than Cade Cunningham, higher than Nikola Jokic, a shade behind Anthony Edwards. I'm very curious to see how those two guys fit together. You got to get the ball to Anthony Edwards' hands. You got to be able to get someone who can get him the ball and place his where he can make things happen without being faced with double teams.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte's need to build around Brandon Miller
quotes.excerpt: They had to do something for Brandon Miller. They had to do it.
quotes.quote: They had to do something for Brandon Miller. They had to do it. Charlotte was like, we got Brandon Miller, that's the guy we're going to build around. He's 21 years old. If we can get a return for LaMelo Ball that we like, we probably should do it now, because he's coming off a season where he only missed 10 games and showed some durability.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Coby White's role and contract value for the Hornets
quotes.excerpt: It clears out the way for them to sign Coby White to a three-year, $74 million deal.
quotes.quote: It clears out the way for them to sign Coby White to a three-year, $74 million deal. Now Coby White shot I think 40% from three after he got traded there last year. So you've got that, you've got him to balance out with Brandon Miller, and he's going to be how much cheaper? LaMelo is at $44 million over the next three years, Coby is going to be $25 million. It's going to be somewhat comparable production for a lot less money.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeff Peterson's decision to move on from LaMelo Ball
quotes.excerpt: Jeff cleaned them up and got them out. Smart.
quotes.quote: A GM that I asked about this deal, one of the things he said about LaMelo was, Jeff cleaned them up and got them out. Smart. Jeff Peterson, the Hornets GM, basically saying, hey, LaMelo had minimal value a year ago, had a good year, they won some games, he was on the floor, restored his value to a certain point, and boom, pounced on an opportunity to trade him once there was some value.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota's power forward problem after the trade
quotes.excerpt: You've got a potential star solution to what was a glaring hole at point guard.
quotes.quote: Yes, Anthony Edwards is going to be happy with this. Yes, you've got a potential star solution to what was a glaring hole at point guard. But the wack-a-mole thing here is, pop, you got a power forward problem now. Someone with the Wolves told me, we went from 48 minutes of outstanding power forward play to zero. I'm guessing they'll bump Jaden McDaniels up to the four, they might start those three guards with Anthony Edwards. But they've got some things to figure out and not a lot of flexibility to figure it out as far as what they're going to do at that four spot.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Salary cap implications for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: This still vastly reduced salary, because Julius Randle, Naz Reid's salary and Randle's salary is slightly higher.
quotes.quote: There was a lot of questioning the Wolves after the Julius Randle trade, including by us, me especially, about salary dumping. And there's been like, well, okay, well this is, they put the money back. Not quite. This still vastly reduced salary, because Julius Randle, Naz Reid's salary and Randle's salary is slightly higher. But it still is going to put them in position where they're not going to be able to use their exceptions or use their full mid-level, I don't think. And if they're going to be in the tax, I don't know if they're going to use their many mid-levels.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's role and importance to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Rudy is going to be happy. He's going to be getting lobbed up.
quotes.quote: If it's those three guards, McDaniels and Rudy. And by the way, Rudy is going to be happy. He's going to be getting lobbed up and he's never been more important to his team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: I would assume that Charlotte asked for Rob Dillingham.
quotes.quote: I would assume, I don't know this to be sure, I mean I'll do some reporting on this, I would assume that Charlotte asked for Rob Dillingham. My guess is the Wolves were like, listen, we're not, I don't know this, but my guess is that the Wolves were like, Rob Dillingham's off limits, because they needed Rob Dillingham to be part of this.
